verdict.rationale: Motion has a live, documented REST API with X-API-Key auth that agents could call as a tool, and an agent-oriented llms.txt. However, the documented API scope is creating and managing projects and tasks, not the scheduling objects the story names; booking templates and embeddable booking calendars appear only as UI features. Missing for 10: an official MCP server, API or tool exposure of availability, bookings, and event types (meeting templates), and agent tool-calling documentation or hands-on corroboration.
